reason: I'd send it a few nota for free, sure, but I'm not paying until I see it read my guys' scrawled handwritten nota from the supply shop correctly. And 'forward it and forget about it' is the opposite of how I run things since I caught someone padding receipts. Excel and my own checking cost me nothing.
objection: Catching duplicates is fine, but the real trick on my sites is a nota with a bigger number written on it. A bot that just copies that number into a sheet doesn't stop that. I still have to check it against the shop myself, so what am I paying for?
would_change_my_mind: If during the free 30 it reads a pile of my own messy Indonesian nota without mistakes and flags a real double-claim or a padded total I would have missed, then I'd pay the $35 without thinking twice.
